purpose: Let a mobile visitor explicitly reduce tracking image work while preserving aspect, session ownership and honest AI/backend reporting.

contract.presets: Standard retains a 256-pixel long edge; light uses 192. Select only while stopped, freeze the chosen size for a session, apply it to camera and sample frames and follow intrinsic rotations. Admit 64-pixel minimum sides and reject unsupported ratios or presets without stretching.
contract.claims: At a 4:3 aspect ratio light has 27,648 rather than 49,152 image pixels, a 43.75% reduction in copied/tracked pixel count. The pinned AI model and rate cap remain unchanged; no AI inference, physical speed, power, memory or accuracy improvement is asserted.
contract.verification: Exercise both presets and actual WASM sample tracking, real pinned-model mask geometry in light portrait/landscape synthetic capture, stopped-only settings, no camera permission for samples and existing lifecycle/CSP controls. No physical-phone or Safari qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, frozen native binaries, prior camera outputs, resolved Cargo.lock and release WASM. No Rust/native/core/GPU changes, compiler runs, sensor acquisition or new SDK/model acquisition.

resources.strategy: Hard-link existing hash-identical vendor files into a fresh E: site. Reuse the release WASM, matching bindgen and installed browser/runtime; keep all evidence and failures.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero covers local SDK/model acquisition. After publication bounded HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without persisting vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Measured canonical calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
